records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no tickets. Two Wrenfield outreach emails ([email:25bf5044], [email:3b8f1b30]) went unanswered, with no customer reply anywhere in the thread, suggesting low engagement. 8 days remain, so self-start is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Maple Labs started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

I know the first week gets busy, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
